reviews.title: Long time coming but well worth it.
reviews.comment: The monitor has been an excellent upgrade from my Vizio E390i-A1. It wasn't compatible with my RX 9060 XT 16GB, causing strange display scaling and glitches. It's behaving beautifully now and 240Hz is such a game changer. The screen looks wonderful! The reds are so vivid and the colors look pleasant to the eye. I can now game and work on my art commissions with confidence. The twitch stream was on its lowest quality, I was waiting for a drop. It looks sharp and smooth when playing 1080p 60fps streams. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Matthew
